function.name: releases_api_ReleasesApi_delete_release
function.description: Deletes a specific release identified by a unique release ID. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

releaseId.description: The unique identifier of the release to be deleted. This is typically a UUID.

function.name: releases_api_ReleasesApi_post_release
function.description: Create a new release in the system, assigning it an unique identifier and storing release metadata. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

version.description: The version number of the release following semantic versioning.

description.description: A detailed description of the release contents and changes made.

is_prerelease.description: Indicates whether the release is a pre-release version.

release_date.description: The date of the release in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. If not provided, defaults to the current date.

release_time.description: The time of the release in the format 'HH:MM:SS'. If not provided, defaults to the current time.

function.name: releases_api_ReleasesApi_put_release
function.description: Updates the details of an existing release using the specified release ID. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

releaseId.description: The unique identifier of the release to be updated.

releaseName.description: The new name for the release.

releaseDate.description: The release date in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

isMajorRelease.description: Indicates whether this is a major release.
